title: The Canon of the Last Bloom
summary: A canon for those who join the death stream and the life stream at the boundary where a thing ends and flowers once more.

title: Treatise of the Terminus Soul
summary: A treatise on the death stream joined to the soul stream so that the ending reaches what the life leaves behind.

title: The Manual of the Final Silence
summary: A manual of the death stream and the void stream joined at the principle of cessation until sound and thing both cease.
